known_open: Bukkit and scheduling boundaries are mocked. Fault injection discards committed replies; no real server process was started or killed.
The coordinated protocol is recoverable across authorities, not an instantaneous cross-database transaction; a receiver can complete before another resumes.

Army and cuboid source proof budgets are one MiB. Large scopes can be rejected before source binding. Existing unbound Army rows written by older code gain the budget on subsequent authority commits; no offline data migration was run.
Foundation chunk cession, siege, legacy military restriction migration and permissioned lifting, lease/reparation/tribute/loan money remain open.
Navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel, other module authorization/thread/lifecycle and archival remain open.
